review_notes: Implementation provides comprehensive localStorage-based persistence with automatic fallback to in-memory storage. Code follows functional programming principles with proper input validation, type checking, and extensive error handling. Test coverage includes unit tests, integration tests, edge cases, and property-based tests. All 97 tests pass with excellent coverage metrics (94.8% lines, 96.2% functions). Implementation correctly handles both AC-7 (persistence) and AC-8 (graceful degradation) requirements with proper serialization, quota exceeded handling, and transparent fallback behavior.
